name: Nishino Chikage
source:
A highly capable woman who serves as the branch manager of Ninmori Trading Company's Matsunami Branch.

Despite having only a small staff, she manages her elite team effectively and consistently produces good business results.

Initially, she frowns upon Kensuke's work attitude when he arrives as temporary support for the branch. However, as he gradually begins showing more enthusiasm and dedication, she becomes increasingly fond of him and starts treating him affectionately.

Her beauty is so remarkable that rumors about her have reached even the company's head office. She also boasts a figure comparable to that of a professional model.

On the other hand, she has become so absorbed in her work that she has little opportunity to make use of her attractive body, leaving her physical desires unfulfilled.

[Translated from [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/11700]the official site[/url]]
